fields.subject: DbParameterExtensions
fields.condition: a caller extracts a non-nullable scalar from a Query contract parameter whose value is DBNull, other than via GetDouble, GetFloat or GetGuid, which return a sentinel instead of throwing
fields.trigger: the caller invokes the typed scalar getter
fields.response: throw UnexpectedNullException with the requested CLR type and parameter name
